facts.value: A corollary of the rule of law is the existence of a legal profession sufficiently autonomous to invoke the authority of the independent judiciary; the right to assistance of a barrister in a court proceeding emanates from this corollary—in England, the function of barrister or advocate is distinguished from legal counselor.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: The practice of law is typically overseen by a government or an independent regulatory body, such as a bar association, bar council, or law society.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Modern lawyers achieve a distinct professional identity through specified legal procedures, such as successfully passing a qualifying examination and obtaining a special qualification (a legal education that earns the student a Bachelor of Laws, a Bachelor of Civil Law, or a Juris Doctor degree).
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Higher academic degrees may include a Master of Laws, a Master of Legal Studies, a Bar Professional Training Course, or a Doctor of Laws.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Lawyers are constituted in office by legal forms of appointment, such as being admitted to the bar.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Titles of respect for lawyers include Esquire, which indicates barristers of greater dignity, and Doctor of Law, which signifies a person who obtained a PhD in Law.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Many Muslim countries have developed rules governing legal education and the legal profession, while some still allow lawyers trained in traditional Islamic law to practice before personal status courts.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: In China and other developing countries, there are not sufficient professionally trained individuals to staff the existing judicial systems, leading to relaxed formal standards.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Once accredited, a lawyer may work in a law firm, in chambers as a sole practitioner, in a government post, or in a private corporation as an internal counsel.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Many people trained in law utilize their skills outside the legal field.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Legal research to determine the current state of the law typically involves exploring case-law reports, legal periodicals, and legislation.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Law practice involves drafting documents such as court pleadings, persuasive briefs, contracts, wills, and trusts.
facts.programme_association: Law, Human Rights in Criminal Justice - LLM or MA

facts.value: Negotiation and dispute resolution skills (including ADR techniques) are also essential to legal practice, depending on the field.
